assets.label: Yakovlev Yak-3
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: polished Age of Fronts strategy-game unit sprite, one WWII Soviet Yakovlev Yak-3 fighter, transparent PNG.
Camera: STRICT vertically overhead orthographic plan view, 90 degrees down onto upper surfaces. Nose points straight up, tail down, fuselage on vertical centerline. Wings level. Absolutely no perspective, isometric angle, banking, visible fuselage sidewalls or underside.
Subject: a recognizable wartime Yak-3, compact low-wing single-engine fighter. Slim inline-engine cowling with one small spinner and exactly THREE propeller blades, correct top-down propeller projection. One narrow teardrop glazed bubble cockpit aft of wing leading edge, compact smoothly tapered wings with rounded tips, conventional horizontal tailplane, a single vertical fin represented only as a narrow central ridge. Wingspan to fuselage length approximately 9.2 to 8.55. Retracted gear, no external bombs or pylons. ONE complete airplane only.
Finish: realistic finely hand-painted 2D game artwork, crisp silhouette and substantial readable painted shapes, restrained weathering, subdued panel seams, satin painted wood/metal, gentle material highlights, dark blue-gray cockpit glazing. WWII Soviet gray and blue-gray camouflage on upper surfaces, understated red five-point Soviet stars near BOTH wing tips with thin pale outlines. Stars are recognizable without covering most of the wing. No lettering or serial numbers. Avoid excessive rivets on the wooden rear fuselage. Authentic aircraft construction rather than a generic Spitfire silhouette.
Framing: square canvas, centered, wingspan 80 percent of canvas width, entire aircraft including every propeller tip, nose and tail comfortably inside frame, at least 7 percent empty border on all sides. Genuine clear transparent alpha outside plane, clean anti-aliased edges. No ground shadow, scenery, clouds, sky, runway, ground, smoke, detached pieces, labels or watermark. No jets, no wheels, no weapons firing. Static master for approval before animation.

assets.label: Petlyakov Pe-8
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Age of Fronts strategy game unit sprite, one Soviet WWII Petlyakov Pe-8 heavy bomber, square transparent PNG.
STRICT camera: exactly vertically overhead orthographic plan view of the top surfaces. Nose pointing straight to the TOP, tail down. Level wings, absolutely no isometric view, banking, pitch, sidewalls or visible underside.
Subject: Pe-8 heavy bomber in wartime AM-35A inline-engine configuration, distinctive wide-span tapered wings and slender substantial fuselage. Wingspan to full aircraft length about 39.1 to 23.6: wing span distinctly broader than nose-to-tail length. EXACTLY FOUR matched inline-engine nacelles, TWO on each wing, mirrored locations with nacelles coherently joined to wings. Each nacelle projects ahead of leading edge with a small spinner; each propeller is a VERTICAL disc perpendicular to flight direction, so in this strict overhead view its blades project as a THIN nearly horizontal lateral stroke across the spinner. NOT flat horizontal three-blade fans, NOT helicopter rotors. Four propellers total. One glazed rounded bomber nose, framed stepped cockpit behind it, one small dark dorsal turret behind main wings, conventional horizontal tailplane and ONE vertical tail represented only as thin center ridge. Closed bomb bay, landing gear retracted. No bombs or missiles outside aircraft.
Style: premium realistically painted 2D strategy game art, crisp clean silhouette at tiny scale, subtle panel seams, modest paint wear, restrained non-glittery material highlights. Wartime matte green-and-black disruptive camouflage, dark blue-gray framed glazing, small red five-point stars with narrow pale borders near both outer wing panels for culture readability. No lettering, serial numbers or white tail band. No giant toy-like insignia, no jets, no modern geometry. Structural detail should support the large bomber role without noisy rivets.
Framing: one complete aircraft centered on a square transparent canvas, full wingspan occupying approximately 82 percent of canvas width with ample clear margin around ALL tips. Whole aircraft plus all propeller tips inside frame. Genuine transparent alpha outside aircraft, no background, checkerboard, sky, ground, cast ground shadow, clouds, motion blur, smoke, captions, people or watermark. Static master for approval before animation.
